Sniper AVGO: after Monday's close BofA, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley announced a $63B SPV that buys Broadcom XPU accelerators and networking for lease to Anthropic (deliveries from 2027; Broadcom gives residual value support equal to the first lien, a vendor-financing risk); Anthropic's S-1 lists about $161B of Broadcom lease payments. DA Davidson upgraded AVGO to Buy (Daily Trade Alert list; not yet in the Benzinga rating feed, so not independently confirmed). Pre-market 340.00 vs 329.17 close (+3.3%, about 1.7% beyond SMH): at the edge of the ~3% bar for a heavy catalyst. AI hardware has been the cooling theme for a month (SMH -10% 1 month) but rebounded Monday. ANALYST.md: AVGO's 2 rating events did not carry (median -0.7%). catalyst_open buys only while AVGO is at or above its open; a carried position would sit through tomorrow's FOMC (owner 10-23: sniper continues on FOMC days)
